newsitem.title: UK: Quarter of world mammals face extinction - report.
newsitem.headline: Quarter of world mammals face extinction - report.

text.p: A quarter of the world's mammals are threatened with extinction, according to a report by a conservation group.
The Red List from the IUCN, the World Conservation Union, claims 911 animal species are in danger of becoming extinct in the next few years.
"The most significant finding is that 25 percent of mammals are threatened," Georgina Mace of the Institute of Zoology in London who helped produce the report told The Independent newspaper.
Mace added that freshwater species of fish, reptile and amphibian are probably the most endangered.

The newspaper said that according to the report 169 species of mammals are critically endangered, with destruction of natural habitat, hunting, collection for the pet trade and pollution cited as the main causes.
